entities.summary: Ivan Huml is a retired Czech professional ice hockey player whose career spanned over a decade in both North America and Europe. Selected 59th overall by the Boston Bruins in the second round of the 2000 NHL Entry Draft, he went on to play 49 regular‑season games with the Bruins over three seasons, recording 6 goals, 12 assists, and 18 points, along with 36 penalty minutes. After his time in the NHL, Huml continued his career in several elite European leagues, including the Czech Extraliga, Finland's SM‑liiga, and Sweden's Elitserien.
